Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class TutorReportController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.TutorReportController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/tutor") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class TutorReportController extends Object
Controller that generates a PDF report for a specific tutor. Provides detailed statistics about bookings, students, subjects, and reviews.

  • Method Details

    • generateTutorPdfReport

      @GetMapping("/{tutorId}/reports/pdf") @PreAuthorize("(#tutorId == authentication.principal and hasRole(\'TUTOR\')) or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<byte[]> generateTutorPdfReport(@PathVariable Integer tutorId, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE) LocalDate from, @RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DATE) LocalDate to, @RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="true") Boolean includeStudents, @RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="true") Boolean includeSubjects, @RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="") List<Integer> subjectIds, @RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="true") Boolean includeReviews, @RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="5") Integer reviewsN) throws IOException
      Generates a PDF report for a tutor.
      Parameters:
      tutorId - the ID of the tutor
      from - start date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional, defaults to 30 days before today
      to - end date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional, defaults to today
      includeStudents - whether to include the list of students
      includeSubjects - whether to include the subjects table
      subjectIds - optional list of subject IDs to filter (empty = all)
      includeReviews - whether to include student reviews
      reviewsN - number of latest reviews to include (1-100, default 5)
      Returns:
      PDF file as byte array with Content-Disposition attachment header
      Throws:
      IOException - if PDF generation fails
